items.title: Video Editor autosave restoration
items.summary: Fixed project reopen so saved clip trim ranges, split segments, ordering, mute, volume, global transition, zoom, and playhead are hydrated onto the reloaded media.

items.title: Saved Video Editor project and Share to X flow
items.summary: Changed Share to X to open the caption sheet immediately. Any required timeline bake now begins only after Post to X, so users can review or change the saved caption first.

items.title: AI film editing, undo, autosave, and time-zero loading
items.summary: Routed Generate prompt interpretation through `/api/video/edit-prompt` with the current AI Prompt key, provider, and model. The local parser remains the failure fallback.

items.title: AI Film Edit Generate and encoder fallback
items.summary: Fixed Generate stopping after prompt improvement because it called nonexistent `extractSpotifyMusic` instead of the exported URL extractor.

items.title: Wrist camera direct activation
items.summary: Fixed the Robotics > Cameras > Wrist cams action so it restarts camera publishing through the authenticated Studio API before opening the floating Left and Right windows. Robot teleop remains disarmed and no Robot Activate click is required.

items.title: Spatial AI Draw with live voice
items.summary: In VR Draw, lasso a surface, talk with live voice, Smart Description, then Generate only when you press it.

items.title: Saved viewport split layouts
items.summary: Save a named mosaic of Viewport / Wiring / Parts List, then share or import the layout like any other preview.

items.title: Cmd/Ctrl+F finder
items.summary: Spotlight search across your projects, prompts, and timeline. Cmd+F on Mac, Ctrl+F on Windows — does not steal find-in-page from the prompt.

items.title: Send catalog parts to wiring
items.summary: From Parts Catalog, Send to wiring so the sourced part and pins land in the Wiring prompt — no re-search.

items.title: Pin projects in the project menu
items.summary: Star up to five personal projects so they stay at the top of the Projects list. Finder can pin too.

items.title: Marketplace viewport layouts
items.summary: Browse free Viewport layouts, Install into the general layout store, then apply on any project.

items.title: GitHub OAuth through Supabase
items.summary: Link GitHub still returns to /oauth/github/callback. OAuth App credentials live in the Supabase Auth GitHub provider; user PATs are encrypted on the Users row. Pasted keys in AI chat are routed the same way — never into git or the browser.

items.title: Debug self-improve skill + community training () @milestone
items.summary: Debugger template `ai-context/skills/debug-self-improve/SKILL.md` (mirrored in `mcp/grok-bot/skills/`) teaches Grok to bind traceback_id + feature check, read the last Render frame, kill one of two hypotheses, actually fix the bug, then file a retro: prompts_used, hours_elapsed,

items.title: 42 feature GIFs + auto Updates publish
items.summary: 42 feature GIFs + auto Updates publish

items.title: Wiring 3D / AR
items.summary: Bottom-left AR/3D controls, isolated wiring rendering, and contact-only 1:1 AR placement.

items.title: Reviewed VR voice companion
items.summary: Right-wrist agent with audio-reactive avatar. Spoken edits require review; throw dismisses the panel.

items.title: Connecting wrist cameras
items.summary: Plug Arducam-style wrist USB cameras into the Mac running Studio. Wrist Cam auto-publishes JPEGs on :8001 — no curl on the happy path.

items.title: Pin to public profile
items.summary: Public projects can be pinned on your public profile so visitors see the featured models first.

items.title: Native FreeCAD assembly joints
items.summary: Author the 13 FreeCAD Assembly joint types, save Joints / FCStd, and export STEP + joints for Fusion.

items.title: Edit Selected — scale and attachment
items.summary: Edits keep source-to-assembly placement and scale. Failed results do not clobber the live body.

items.title: Code workspace
items.summary: Nested explorer with syntax tabs, JSON/CSV/XLSX/PDF previews, and revision-checked saves that survive project switches.

items.title: Even CAD mode chips
items.summary: Compose toolbar chips (Render / CAD / Mesh / Parts / Speed-Quality / Improve) share equal width on one row.

items.title: Viser LAN proxy and robotics Cloud settings
items.summary: Viser on a robot PC is reachable through Studio's same-origin LAN proxy. Robotics Cloud settings save the Viser URL so HTTPS render3d.app can embed it.

items.title: Connect your database (self-host)
items.summary: Point this clone at YOUR Supabase, or keep sqlite local users.

items.title: Teleop HTTPS proxy
items.summary: DIMOS /teleop is HTTPS. Studio proxies it so Quest never sees the self-signed Pi cert.

items.title: Robotics Configuration
items.summary: Connect Viser (HTTP LAN) and OpenArm Quest Teleop (HTTPS) through Studio proxies so a laptop on https://render3d.app never hits mixed content or a self-signed Pi cert.

items.title: Reference files folders and captures
items.summary: Reference Files and Renders nest into folders (McMaster, Screenshots, Screen Recordings, AR captures, Improve Lab) so captures stay organized.

items.title: AI film-edit on the clip timeline
items.summary: Under the clip editor, prompt a cut, Improve prompt, then Generate a film edit without leaving Studio.

items.title: Clip / video editor tab
items.summary: Viewport recordings open a built-in clip editor — timeline, trim, grades, stills, and drag-and-drop media — without leaving Studio.

items.title: VR Robot / DIMOS stays gated until Enable
items.summary: Quest robotics and DIMOS teleop stay off until you Enable Robotics or Activate. Cloud never exposes :8443; the LAN proxy stays on this Mac.

items.title: VR world menu & laser
items.summary: Quest menu-aim uses the posed controller ray. Trigger clicks HUD; DimOS does not steal picks while the menu is hit.

items.title: Share link & remix
items.summary: Copy a share link; signed-in visitors remix into a new project or an existing shared workspace.

items.title: Remix into a shared workspace
items.summary: Remix can add to an existing shared workspace or create a new one — not create-only.

items.title: Prompt drafts persist and Studio boots faster
items.summary: Compose drafts stay with the project when you switch files, and desktop boot no longer holds a minimum splash delay.

items.title: Imagine panel — image gen, grid/list, and /fetch
items.summary: Imagine is its own tab next to Compose and History, separate from Agent and Improve. Generate product images, switch grid or list, and /fetch public CAD into the project.

items.title: DXF convert preferences
items.summary: Choose ask / auto / always DXF / always image so line drawings become CAD instead of a photo.

items.title: Viewport document tab strip
items.summary: Image, PDF, McMaster, and DXF open as parked tabs. 3D stays in the DOM — no close-to-return.

items.title: Control Center on the admin dashboard
items.summary: Management now has a Control Center overlay for live health, prompt volume, DIMOS coordinator, and ops toggles — without replacing the existing dashboard.

items.title: Workspace invite by email
items.summary: Invite teammates from the workspace popup with typeahead profiles — no retyping the full address.

items.title: Suggestions overlay
items.summary: After boot, send a suggestion with attachments. Sent closes the overlay; email + inbox notify ops.

items.title: Settings search
items.summary: Type in Preferences or Management to jump to a setting instead of hunting sections.

items.title: Receive money — Stripe, PayPal, X, wallets
items.summary: Creators connect Stripe / PayPal / X / wallets from account so Marketplace payouts have a destination.

items.title: Parts Catalog replaces Insert
items.summary: The Insert design tab is gone. Parts Catalog is the home for McMaster-Carr, STEP library parts, and the STEP file manager.

items.title: Kernel measure
items.summary: Measure prefers FreeCAD/OCC vertex/edge/face distance from the STEP, with mesh centroid as fallback.

items.title: FreeCAD is the source of truth for move, delete, and extrude
items.summary: Move, delete, and Extrude/Pad/Pocket now persist on the FreeCAD/OCC STEP document instead of a mesh-only preview, so parts stay put after refresh.

items.title: Agent panel — four tabs on one row
items.summary: Render Agent uses four tabs on a single row so help, skills, history, and settings stay in reach.

items.title: Texture wrap on the model
items.summary: Texture to model wraps the image on the object. Timeline undo; files mini-browser. Render Improve is object-only.

items.title: SolidWorks library import / export
items.summary: Import and export SolidWorks library parts alongside Fusion / Onshape cloud libraries.

items.title: Share captures to X
items.summary: Mobile and VR POV Screenshot / Record, then markup and Share to X without leaving the capture flow.

items.title: Recording HUD
items.summary: Recording HUD docks, drags, and can hide from the clip so the overlay is not burned into the video.

items.title: Public room — drop a project
items.summary: In a public VR room, drop a project both people can pick up and inspect together.

items.title: Public projects appear live
items.summary: Pushing a project to Public shows it for other people without a refresh, including Discord announcements when enabled.

items.title: Plus starts a new project immediately
items.summary: The + next to Projects creates a project right away — blank viewport, no extra wizard.

items.title: Improve Lab
items.summary: Improve Lab keeps facing-locked Render wraps and CAD Improve experiments next to the project.

items.title: Context Lab — machines & customers
items.summary: Context Lab stores machines and customers so Improve and Generate can reuse shop context.

items.title: Share ChatGPT CAD with a team
items.summary: ChatGPT / Codex sessions live on workspaces. Manage AI keys and subscriptions; trial is 3 ChatGPT renders.

items.title: Fullscreen capture + mini browser
items.summary: Screenshots and recordings open fullscreen with a mini browser for images and PDFs.

items.title: Calendars and meeting requests
items.summary: Profile calendars plus meeting requests so a teammate can book time without leaving Studio.

items.title: Mobile studio chrome
items.summary: Phone layout: hamburger menu, profile top-right, tools FAB, locked viewport so orbit does not fight chrome.

items.title: Fritzing pictorial skins
items.summary: Every wiring part can show a Fritzing pictorial skin so the breadboard matches the real component.

items.title: Exploded view
items.summary: Explode an assembly to inspect mates. Turning it off reloads the assembled parent — rotate does not collapse it.

items.title: XR captures land in AR references
items.summary: Quest screenshots and videos save under Reference Files → AR, and the PC shows a capture-ready popup without needing a refresh.

items.title: VR recording matches the headset view
items.summary: VR clips record a true head-centered spectator view with correct FOV, and include Explorer + AI windows so recordings look like what you see in the headset.

items.title: Rigging moves real CAD parts
items.summary: URDF/SRDF motion now drives the real __part_*.glb meshes instead of white box placeholders, so jaws and links animate like Jake text-to-CAD.

items.title: Right-click delete for reference files
items.summary: Reference Files and Renders now support right-click Delete (and Rename) in the project browser, including AR captures and open image viewers.

items.title: Green AI VR icon while generating
items.summary: In headset, the left-hand dock AI VR control turns green and pulses while a generation is running, and the AI panel header shows AI VR · GENERATING…

items.title: POV Screenshot & Record → Share to X
items.summary: Mobile and VR expose POV Screenshot and Record controls, with markup and Share to X after capture so headset and phone clips are easy to post.

items.title: Mesh Stop restores draft and costs
items.summary: Stopping a Mesh generation restores your compose draft like Mode 2.0 and refreshes history so canceled runs still show usage and cost.

items.title: Mesh Improve for realistic materials
items.summary: Mesh Improve follows img2threejs look-dev rules: independent PBR, finish recipes, wear and locality, and named mesh parts instead of flat toy colors.

items.title: Faster Create share link
items.summary: Creating a share link is much snappier — it bakes the viewer GLB only (companions stay on Export) and Copy share link stays pinned at the top of Export.

items.title: Bambu 3MF: real parts on real plates
items.summary: Send to Bambu Studio now packs printable plates correctly — unique mesh IDs per body, one assembled plate by default, Preparing assembly… while multi-body packs, and only unhidden parts export.

items.title: GPT-5.5 Pro defaults to Speed
items.summary: Selecting GPT-5.5 Pro auto-sets Mode to Speed so expensive Quality pricing is not left on by accident; you can still switch to Quality manually.

items.title: Source parts with ⓘ and drag into Wiring AI
items.summary: Click ⓘ on a component to identify and source it online, then drag the sourced part into the Wiring Simulator AI prompt for pin-aware circuits.

items.title: Source parts with ⓘ into Wiring AI
items.summary: Click ⓘ on a component to search and link a catalog part, then drag the sourced component into the Wiring Simulator AI prompt for pin-aware circuits.

items.title: Visual Skills Library
items.summary: Skills Library now has a visual browser with grid, list, and compact views, sortable cards, searchable previews, expanded skill details, and store links.

items.title: Transparent viewport tool
items.summary: Click Transparent next to Grid/Color, then click any object to see through it. Crease edges stay crisp in Studio and share preview so internals remain readable.

items.title: Render history in timeline
items.summary: The project timeline now colors 2.0 prompts yellow, renders purple, and shows prompt text plus tracked render cost metadata directly in history.

items.title: Solid modeling tools
items.summary: Ribbon Create/Modify/Pattern plus direct tools: Press-Pull, fillet, transform, color, measure.

items.title: Skills media cards
items.summary: Skills Library cards are now a tighter square grid with animated previews, richer More Info explanations, and local GIF or short clip previews per skill.

items.title: Constrained Sketch
items.summary: 2D sketch on a plane with constraints, then extrude to solid.
